About GenoKit
=============

GenoKit is developed by Sitao Zhu. The current package metadata declares the
MIT license and version 1.0.0. These pages document the source implementation
reviewed on 8 October 2026, rather than every historical release.

* Source and issue tracker: https://github.com/SitaoZ/GenoKit
* Python distribution: https://pypi.org/project/GenoKit/
* Web interface: http://www.genokit.cn/
* Contact: zhusitao1990@163.com

When citing an analysis, record the actual version/source revision, input data
releases and analysis parameters. Use the project's released citation metadata
when available; these documentation pages do not assign a publication DOI to
an unpublished manuscript.

Contributions and bug reports are welcome. Provide a small reproducible input,
the exact CLI command and the complete error output. For workflow limitations
and input checks, see :doc:`faq`.
